faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before we start
faq.q1-answer: This fee covers the complete design and development of your website. The domain and hosting are registered in your name to ensure you have 100% ownership of your site.
faq.q2-question: What are the additional costs for?
faq.q2-answer: Every website needs a domain (address) and hosting (server space). These are external utility services. Think of it like renting a physical space for your shop-it's a necessary base cost that you pay directly to the service provider.
faq.q3-question: Are there any recurring monthly fees?
faq.q3-answer: No. There are no monthly maintenance fees. You pay once for the build, and your website belongs to you, working independently without any mandatory ongoing costs.
faq.q4-question: When will my website be live?
faq.q4-answer: You will receive a fully functional, mobile-responsive website ready for customers in exactly 7 days.
faq.q5-question: Who handles the technical maintenance of the website?
faq.q5-answer: We offer a 'stress-free' management package starting from 50₾ per month. This covers hosting management, SSL security, daily backups, and business email setup. We handle the technical side so you can focus on your business. Of course, this is optional-if you prefer to manage the hosting yourself, you are free to do so.
